Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with 5 on hand.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425698 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425698-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with a line holding part A picked from stock.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425698 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the work order's Lines tab, in the line's Parts row click + Add Part, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425698-A in Part number, pick the result that shows Inventory Qty, type 1 in Qty *, then click Save.
  • Create a canned job for this test, canned job A, saved from that line, so it holds part A.
    • How to do it: On work order 1's Lines tab click the three-dot icon on the line, click Save as canned line, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425698 CANNED JOB A in Line Title and click Save As Canned Line.
  • Use a new part number that no part and no Part Library entry has yet, and that does not contain part A's number.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
